# billymes-webui — agent index

Read [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) first. It is the concise operating contract and
routes to the detailed rules.

## Start here

- Runtime contract: Node.js 24.x and pnpm 11.x.
- [`README.md`](README.md) — package integration and production-wrapper
  overview.
- [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md) — documentation index and source-of-truth
  policy.
- [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) — current ownership and
  dependency boundaries.
- [`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md) — local workflow and verification
  commands.
- [`docs/reviews/2026-08-26-inherited-code-review.md`](docs/reviews/2026-08-26-inherited-code-review.md)
  — full inherited-code review, remediations, and accepted boundaries.

## Architecture sources

- [`architecture.json`](architecture.json) is the machine-readable ownership
  contract; its fail-closed checker is authoritative for structural drift.
- `src/app/` composes the application.
- `src/features/*/` owns feature behavior and exposes a narrow public entrypoint.
- `src/shared/` owns reusable, feature-neutral code.
- `server/gateway-proxy.ts` owns the gateway forwarding boundary.
- [Chat capsule hazards](src/features/chat/AGENTS.md) cover profile/session
  generations, persistent controller cleanup, reconnect, and interrupt.
- [Gateway security boundary](src/features/gateway/AGENTS.md) covers loopback-only
  serving, origin-bound token storage, and proxy header hygiene.

## Decisions and long goals

- [`docs/adr/README.md`](docs/adr/README.md) indexes accepted durable decisions.
- [`docs/adr/0001-feature-capsules.md`](docs/adr/0001-feature-capsules.md)
  records the feature-capsule boundary.
- [`docs/adr/0003-lazy-heavy-render-runtimes.md`](docs/adr/0003-lazy-heavy-render-runtimes.md)
  records the split JavaScript budget and the lazy math/animation runtimes.
- [`loop-develop/README.md`](loop-develop/README.md) is used only for an
  explicitly requested long-lived goal or handoff.

Do not treat this index or prose as permission to invent unimplemented runtime
behavior. Verify details in source, `architecture.json`, and the checker.
